$comment: detsim-completeness/1 (contracts 3.18.0; adapters/detector-simulation, docs/dev/detector-simulation/TASK.md 9.5): the result of a backend's collect for one attempt: complete, partial or invalid, with the evidence of each check. A sidecar (runs/<run_id>/completeness.json, or the same file in a failed/ folder), named by the run record's extension.sidecars; not an artifact type. Code checks (detsim_schemas.check_completeness): complete needs every check passed and no missing output; partial or invalid needs a failed or inconclusive check or a missing output; check names are unique; patterns are re-applied with re.fullmatch.
